integrity: The upper bounds are exhaustive over every binary word at the three claimed lengths. The counting recurrence is justified by the fact that every factor created by appending one symbol is a suffix. The verifier also reproduces the published table through length 24 before checking the new values. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a complete finite determination only for binary lengths 25, 26, and 27. It does not settle the general exact formula or prove the proposed cube/near-cube structure at arbitrary lengths.
title: Exact binary closed-rich maxima at lengths 25–27
